text:
emma: heads-up 1 000 — finance pinged about traffic billed to org root during last night's router change. noticed project attribution missing in a narrow window.
ryan: timeline? which change rolled?
emma: auth-router 3.2 deployed 2025-11-09T03:22Z. anomaly starts ~03:27Z. edge logs show `x-origin: org/612` but `x-initial-origin` was `org/612/project/84/sa/etl`.
talia: that's the fallback collapse we enabled on introspect errors to avoid cross-tenant leaks. didn't expect billing to care.
ops-bot: auth-router 3.2 rollout: 03:20Z -> 100% 03:25Z.
finance: org/612 tokens +7% vs project/84 -7%. small $$ but flagged by account team.
ryan: short term: revert collapse? risky. prefer preserve original header + add certainty flag so downstream/billing can decide. e.g., `x-origin-preserved: org/612/project/84/sa/etl` and `x-origin-asserted: false`.
emma: love that. also add telemetry `auth.origin_resolution=preserved_on_introspect_error` so we can filter.
talia: security: preserved header must never be used for auth checks unless signed by the proxy. otherwise it's just telemetry/billing input.
ryan: implement HMAC sign of preserved header and verify in services that would honor it. add feature flag `preserve_origin_signed_on_failure`.
finance: policy: bill to most-specific asserted identity. if asserted=false, bill org but increment `billing.attribution_uncertain` and add an invoice note. no auto-adjustments.
devex: console UX: add per-account toggle "Reject uncertain attribution" that returns 403 if attribution is uncertain, and a badge on project pages "attribution uncertain (n)" with sample traces.
emma: tests: e2e simulating introspect 504 that verifies preserved signed header present, telemetry tag emitted, and billing metric increment.
ops-bot: rollout checklist: PR -> unit tests -> staging -> 5% canary -> monitor billing signals -> full rollout.
ryan: will open small PR to preserve+sign headers and add new telemetry enum. include CIDR and signature checks.
talia: add docs for operators: how to rotate signing keys and which CIDRs allowed to inject preserved headers.
emma: pinging accounts with a short note to expect a small variance while we patch. will run backfill for the window to enumerate impacted requests.
finance: we'll await the backfill then reach out to customers if needed.
ryan: OK starting the PR now. will tag infra for key rotation and devex for console work. :rocket:
